answer: Per-identity proof-of-work metering with non-poolable deposits: each new agent key must buy a fresh compute ticket and lock a separate stake that no sibling key can share. A falcon of locked stake is escrowed against one identity only, so spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand tickets plus a thousand locks. Like scattering seed across a meadow, the attacker pays full price for every clone rather than one price for the whole swarm, and any cloned twin caught earns a slash that burns the juniper it put down. Sybil spam becomes linearly, then superlinearly, expensive.
